saw_lines: Skincare buyers pick one serum for their skin and reorder it for months, so the first bottle must be earned.
So the sale is won or lost in the first line of the ad, where a buyer decides whether this serum is for their skin.
Your site says 100 years and almost 200 years, yet 0 of 5 ads use either number. Lead with one in each creative and open two ads with a review quote.
